entries.proposition: After a low dose of the chemoconvulsant, 6 of 10 knockout mice progressed past the initial spike-wave stage against 4 of 11 wild-type mice.
entries.snippet: 6 of 10 Cntnap2 –/– mice exhibited such seizure progression, whereas only 4 of 11 Cntnap2+/+ mice showed any progression past the initial SWD stage
entries.anchor: Results, Elevated seizure susceptibility and locomotor activity

entries.proposition: In thalamic slices from knockout mice spontaneous oscillations were commonly observed (7 of 10 slices).
entries.snippet: spontaneous oscillations (n ≥ 10 within a 10 min recording) were commonly observed (7 of 10 slices)

entries.proposition: At a holding potential of minus 60 mV 15 of 18 knockout reticular neurons showed rebound bursts against 9 of 18 wild-type neurons.
entries.snippet: At –60 mV, most (15 of 18) Cntnap2–/– neurons showed rebound bursts compared to about half (9 of 18) Cntnap2+/+ neurons (Fig. 3E)
entries.anchor: Results, Increased burst firing in RT

entries.proposition: The authors report that the low-threshold T-type calcium conductance, which plays a major role in rebound bursting, was significantly increased in knockout neurons.
entries.snippet: Low-threshold T-type calcium conductance, which plays a major role in rebound bursting, was significantly increased in Cntnap2 –/– neurons.
entries.anchor: Results, Increased burst firing in RT

entries.proposition: The authors write that the bursting is likely driven by increased expression of T-type calcium channels.
entries.snippet: likely driven by increased expression of T-type calcium channels
entries.anchor: Results, Increased burst firing in RT, last sentence
